structural_criteria.duplicate_achiral_graphs: retain first in SHA256(parent id plus seed label) order

external_benchmark.selected_conformers: first min(4,n) in source order for each eligible stereoisomer
external_benchmark.failure_policy: exclude an entire selected parent if any selected conformer fails graph/stereo/finite-coordinate validation; do not backfill
external_benchmark.index_alignment: source offset plus selected conformer index; assert source offsets and matrix lengths
external_benchmark.primary_metric: parent-level ES-AUC with different-stereoisomer pairs positive, equal-distance ties scoring one half
external_benchmark.comparison_unit: constitutional molecular parent; each parent has equal weight
external_benchmark.primary_comparison: persistent response minus unpropagated source ES-AUC
external_benchmark.uncertainty: 5000 fixed-seed paired parent bootstrap resamples, mean difference with percentile 95 percent interval

descriptor.readout: all 18 pooled components divided by max(earlier triangle count,1)
descriptor.normalization: one scalar per parent and representation: RMS norm across all selected conformers, floor 1e-12; no coordinate centering before parity-sensitive kernels
descriptor.distance_histogram: 16 bins from 0 to 12 angstrom for each unordered pair of element groups C,N,O,S,halogen,other; counts divided by number of heavy-atom pairs
descriptor.kernel: Gaussian with sigma=1 on the parent RMS-normalized vectors; sigma=0.5 and 2 are labelled sensitivity analyses
descriptor.independence_boundary: source/generated conformers are empirical support points, not asserted independent equilibrium draws

biological_validation.discovery_source: 256 hash-selected constitutional graphs from the original Chiral Cliffs ChEMBL23 supplement; the linked 512-parent 3DCS activity census is retained separately
biological_validation.discovery_use: query ChEMBL for same-connectivity molecules and fresh exact Ki measurements; do not use source-preaggregated potency or previous train/test labels
biological_validation.selection: 1177 original Ki/nM rows; 717 satisfy the unchanged 6-32-heavy-atom, single-component, fully assigned tetrahedral stereo and same-graph pair criteria. Select first 256 by SHA256(seed label plus achiral SMILES), yielding 512 original compound IDs; ignore all original potency, cliff and ambiguity labels
biological_validation.cohort_addition_timing: Added after structural qualification of the linked 3DCS cohort yielded 7 same-assay human single-protein parents, and after the independent 3DCS representation benchmark. Before calculating descriptor/activity associations on the Chiral Cliffs cohort. Preserve linked-cohort results and label the acquisition amendment; do not call this externally preregistered.
biological_validation.acquisition_amendment: MoleculeACE current 23 Ki tables (commit 7e6de0bd2968c56589c580f2a397f01c531ede26, 40220 source rows) yielded zero within-target stereoisomer graph groups under the frozen structural criteria. Before descriptor or activity-outcome analysis, replace that unavailable candidate source with the existing 512-parent benchmark cohort. Endpoints and eligibility filters are unchanged. Preserve the negative discovery census.
biological_validation.activity_source: fresh ChEMBL API raw snapshots and original assay/document/target identifiers

activity_filters.pchembl_value: finite and reconstructable from positive standard_value

biological_validation.pairing: different fully assigned stereoisomers of an identical achiral graph, measured in the same assay id for the same target; aggregate repeated exact compound/assay records by median pKi
biological_validation.replicate_disagreement: exclude compound/assay aggregates with range exceeding 1 log10 unit; retain all excluded records in audit
biological_validation.same_graph_different_targets: retain target context; never average potencies across targets
biological_validation.cliff_definition: absolute paired difference >=1 pKi unit; descriptive stratification, not trained classification
biological_validation.ensemble_generation: 8 ETKDGv3 conformers per retained stereoisomer, deterministic hash-derived seed, MMFF94s with explicit hydrogens, heavy-atom analysis; retain generation/optimization failures
biological_validation.primary_activity_analysis: Spearman association between Gaussian MMD of the two empirical descriptor ensembles and absolute same-assay pKi difference; aggregate pair/target values equally within each parent for the primary parent-level summary
biological_validation.activity_uncertainty: 5000 parent bootstrap replicates; report all parent and target counts and no causal interpretation
biological_validation.target_order_obstruction: report observed same-pair rank reversals across targets and the exact lower error bound for a target-independent ordering rule
biological_validation.negative_results: retain; do not change thresholds, select better targets, tune descriptor parameters or replace endpoints after outcomes
